## Duration
30 minutes 

#About

The tiny ones can ride a gentle horse. Parent/Guardian/Family Member leads the horse around our grounds. You can have a staff member lead the horse for an additional fee, select Wrangler Support for each rider at check-out. Please note that the wrangler support is not providing child care, and that a family member must be present during the pony ride.
We are so happy when family and friends want to visit the ranch and watch their little friends when they are led around. 

*Everyone accompanying pony rider must complete an online waiver (link is in your confirmation email).*

There will be a **grounds fee of $10 per person for every adult person over 5 after 2 adults**. When you book the pony ride you can select the number of people over 5 and pay for them at time of booking. We can also add those people upon arrival and charge the card on file.

##Important
- Please use adult name for contact information and put child's name in rider field. 
- Pony rides do not go on the trails, they are lead around the property. 
- We use our older and calm horses for pony rides.
- Minors must have waiver signed by parent/guardian, adults accompanying minors must sign waiver. *Link to waiver is in your confirmation email.* 


***Please, plan on arriving 15 minutes prior to your ride time to check-in.***
